name: Comet-Tail Run
introDiscord: A blazing current cuts through the trench like a racetrack. Comet-Tail Barracudas streak through it at impossible speed. Shizuki's signs suggest she absolutely tried racing them.
introTwitch: A blazing current cuts through the trench like a racetrack. Comet-Tail Barracudas streak through it at impossible speed. Shizuki's signs suggest she absolutely tried racing them.

comet-tail-run-approach.prompt: Three routes join the blazing course.

left.message:
A Barracuda rockets beside you.

Apparently the race has begun.

right.message:
A Berry rests beneath Shizuki's race sign:

"SHIZUKI: 0
BARRACUDA: 6
Glimmer stop updating scoreboard."

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary rests beside the course.

comet-tail-run-depths.prompt: The current accelerates through three sharp turns.

left.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Race recovery. I nearly won if distance, speed, and winner are ignored."
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the race-recovery medicine untouched.

right.message:
A Barracuda pulls alongside you.

Rematch.

forward.message: Star Candies have collected behind a cometglass barrier.

comet-tail-run-threshold.prompt: Three blazing lanes converge on The Blazing Course.

left.message: A star-chart coffer sits beside what appears to be a finish marker.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Official training potion. Contents: normal potion."
right.fullHpMessage: You decline the highly advanced athletic supplement.

forward.message:
"A Barracuda streaks across the final lane.

Round seven."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The entire course clears.

Something enormous leaves a blazing trail through the distance.

Use /yes to enter The Blazing Course or /no to retire undefeated by technicality.
bossPromptTwitch:
The entire course clears.

Something enormous leaves a blazing trail through the distance.

Use !yes to enter The Blazing Course or !no to retire undefeated by technicality.
bossRetreatText: You retire from professional Barracuda racing.

boss.revealText:
A colossal Barracuda streaks through the chamber.

Perseid Barracuda reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Perseid slows and disappears down the course.

Somewhere, Shizuki's scoreboard probably just updated itself."
